description: Manage feedback posts and comments, and read tickets, contacts, companies, and changelogs.

featurebase_new_changelog_trigger.description: Runs for each new changelog in Featurebase. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, createdAt, updatedAt

featurebase_new_comment_trigger.description: Runs for each new comment in Featurebase. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, content, postId, createdAt, updatedAt

featurebase_new_company_trigger.description: Runs for each new company in Featurebase. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, email

featurebase_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs for each new conversation in Featurebase. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
